# Portable library v1 fixture

`portable-v1-independent.gp200bundle` is generated by Python's standard `zipfile`, `json`, `struct`, and `hashlib` modules, independently of the Rust codec. Run `python3 tests/fixtures/library/generate_fixture.py` to reproduce it. `checksums.json` records its SHA-256.

The synthetic corpus contains two linked revisions, an unknown model, unknown raw state `2`, a NaN payload, signed zero, duplicate opaque records, Unicode local titles, an opaque original source file, and an unresolved User IR slot reference. It has no vendor preset or hardware-write provenance. Tests also use the separately attributed live read fixture at `assets/demo/read-current-payload.bin`.

This proves the app's portable format can be read from an independent writer. It does not establish vendor `.prst` interoperability or restoration to hardware.
